lines.speaker: board
lines.text: DODGE: the cannons fire harmless orbs down their lanes. In the dungeons, enemy attacks work the same way, except they hurt.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Cross the lanes without being touched. Press SPACE to dash in the direction you are moving, but it needs a moment to recharge, so time it.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: The room keeps count of the orbs you dodge and the ones that clip you.
